scope: Native isolated preseeded 20-task run; one observation per stage, ten same-window cycles; not long-run/GPU/heap-stack acceptance

nativeObjectAudit.coverage: Reachable QObjects via engine, application windows, workspace and controller, including visual children; excludes nonparented C++ value members, JS heap and native/GPU allocations
nativeObjectAudit.observer: Diagnostic objects and retained JSON are included; class/property reads do not instantiate layer groups; visibility candidates may be clipped/transparent

limitations: Reachable QObject graph is not the complete C++/JS/native heap
Nested component subtree counts overlap and cannot be added
ShaderEffectSource count is not allocated GPU texture count
Private ItemLayer enumeration is incomplete; zero parented layer count is not zero layers
Offscreen diagnostic regression is separate from native Windows evidence
Diagnostics omit real tray and managed update jobs
No production UI lifecycle optimization applied
Initial hot-insert and mixed-DPI prototype excluded from final native comparison
